description: This is a Java test class for the ValidateUtil utility, containing unit tests for validation methods within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: ValidateUtilTest
classes.description: Test class for ValidateUtil, focused on validation behavior in OpenMRS API.

methods.name: validate_shouldThrowValidationExceptionIfErrorsOccurDuringValidation
methods.description: Tests that ValidateUtil.validate throws a ValidationException when validation errors occur for a Location object.

methods.name: validate_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfErrorsOccurDuringValidation
methods.description: Tests that a ValidationException with errors is thrown when validation fails for a Location object.

methods.name: validate_shouldReturnImmediatelyIfValidationIsDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that validation is skipped when validation is globally disabled.

methods.name: validate_shouldReturnImmediatelyIfValidationIsDisabledForThread
methods.description: Ensures validation is skipped when disabled for the current thread.

methods.name: validateFieldLength_shouldRejectValueWhenNameIsToLong
methods.description: Checks that validation rejects a PatientIdentifierType with a name exceeding max length.

methods.name: validateFieldLength_shouldNotRejectValueWhenNameIsEqualMax
methods.description: Checks that validation passes when a PatientIdentifierType name is at maximum length.

methods.name: validateFieldLength_shouldReturnImmediatelyIfValidationIsDisabledAndHaveNoErrors
methods.description: Verifies that length validation is skipped when validation is disabled and no errors exist.

methods.name: validate_shouldPopulateErrorsIfObjectInvalid
methods.description: Tests that Errors object is populated when validating an invalid Location.

methods.name: validate_shouldReturnImmediatelyIfValidationIsDisabledAndHaveNoErrors
methods.description: Ensures validation skips when globally disabled, and no errors are present for a Patient.

methods.name: validate_shouldReturnThrowExceptionAlongWithAppropriateMessageIfTheObjectIsInvalid
methods.description: Checks that validation throws ValidationException with correct message when a Drug object exceeds maximum length.
